global_style: A futuristic, dark-mode presentation theme featuring neon cyan and purple glowing waves, floating wireframe containers, and strong tech-focused aesthetics.

identity_anchors: Dark space-blue backgrounds with sweeping, intersecting neon wave vectors
Thin, glowing outlines and wireframe geometric containers (circles, ribbons, speech bubbles)
Gradient-filled UI accents like pill buttons, node stems, and image corner-tags
High-contrast thin white sans-serif typography against dark backdrops

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
